chunks.label: Customer Segments — Customer Strategy
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra serves two distinct audiences:

-   **Customers** --- organisations that purchase or embed the platform.
-   **Users** --- people who use the platform for early emotional
    support.

Our commercial success depends on solving a genuine organisational
problem while creating an experience that employees choose to use.

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Needs
chunks.text:
-   Earlier employee engagement
-   Scalable support before referral
-   Service differentiation
-   Better client outcomes

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Pain Points
chunks.text:
-   Long waiting lists
-   Limited clinical capacity
-   Reactive referrals
-   Pressure to innovate

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Success Measures
chunks.text:
-   Increased engagement
-   Higher client retention
-   Better wellbeing outcomes
-   New recurring revenue

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Secondary Customers
chunks.text:
-   Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providers
-   Workplace wellbeing providers
-   Employee benefits organisations
-   HR and wellbeing consultancies
-   Mid-sized employers (250--5,000 employees)

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Primary User
chunks.text:
Employees experiencing:

-   Stress
-   Anxiety
-   Overwhelm
-   Emotional fatigue
-   Low confidence
-   Early burnout

They are still functioning but recognise they are struggling and want
confidential support.

chunks.label: Customer Segments — User Needs
chunks.text:
Users want to:

-   Feel heard without judgement.
-   Understand what they are feeling.
-   Feel less alone.
-   Reduce stress.
-   Build confidence.
-   Know when to seek further support.

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Jobs To Be Done
chunks.text:
When I begin to struggle...

-   Help me pause.
-   Help me make sense of how I feel.
-   Help me calm my mind.
-   Help me decide my next step.
-   Help me regain confidence.

chunks.label: Customer Segments — Customer Promise
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra helps organisations support people earlier while giving
individuals a safe, compassionate space to pause, reflect and reconnect
before challenges become overwhelming.

Every feature should create value for both the organisation and the
individual.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Our Mission
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra exists to bridge the gap between the first signs of
struggle and formal support.

We create a safe, private and compassionate space where people can
pause, reflect and reconnect before challenges become overwhelming.

We believe earlier conversations create healthier people, stronger
workplaces and better outcomes.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — The Problem
chunks.text:
People rarely wake up one morning unable to work.

Stress accumulates.

Confidence declines.

Performance suffers.

Burnout develops gradually.

Yet support often arrives too late.

Employees can wait weeks or even months for Occupational Health,
counselling or clinical support, leaving a critical gap where people
feel isolated, unsupported and uncertain where to turn.

Organisations need a scalable, ethical way to support people before
problems escalate.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Our Solution
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra is an AI-powered Early Intervention Platform.

Through compassionate conversation and evidence-informed therapeutic
techniques, Sorra helps people:

-   Recognise they're struggling.
-   Understand how they're feeling.
-   Reduce feelings of isolation.
-   Build emotional resilience.
-   Take small positive wellbeing actions.
-   Feel more confident accessing further support when needed.

Sorra complements professional services. It never replaces clinical
care.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Primary Customers
chunks.text:
-   Occupational Health Providers
-   Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Providers
-   Workplace Wellbeing Providers
-   Employee Benefits Organisations
-   Health & Wellbeing Consultancies

chunks.label: Value Proposition — End Users
chunks.text:
Employees experiencing stress, anxiety, emotional fatigue, early
burnout, low confidence and overwhelm before they reach crisis point.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — For Employees
chunks.text:
-   A safe place to pause.
-   Confidential, compassionate conversations.
-   Practical emotional regulation tools.
-   Greater self-awareness.
-   Increased confidence to seek help earlier.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — For Workplace Health Providers
chunks.text:
-   An early intervention layer before referral.
-   Increased engagement with wellbeing services.
-   Extended support between appointments.
-   Greater differentiation within the market.
-   Anonymous wellbeing insight.
-   Scalable support without increasing clinician capacity.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — For Employers
chunks.text:
-   Earlier intervention.
-   Improved employee engagement.
-   Better wellbeing culture.
-   Reduced escalation of wellbeing concerns.
-   Stronger psychological safety.
-   Healthier, more resilient workplaces.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Why We're Different
chunks.text:
Most workplace wellbeing solutions are reactive.

Pause with Sorra is proactive.

Rather than waiting until someone reaches Occupational Health,
counselling or sickness absence, Sorra creates a trusted space where
people can recognise they're struggling and take positive action
earlier.

We combine compassionate AI conversation, reflective journaling, guided
hypnotherapy, responsible AI, ethical escalation pathways and
human-centred design.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Our Philosophy
chunks.text:
We don't diagnose.

We don't replace therapists.

We don't promise outcomes.

We simply create the space for people to pause.

Because sometimes one conversation is enough to change the direction
someone is heading.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Positioning Statement
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra is an AI-powered Early Intervention Platform that helps
people recognise they're struggling, safely explore how they're feeling
and take positive action before challenges become overwhelming.

Designed to complement Occupational Health, Employee Assistance
Programmes and workplace wellbeing services, Sorra provides the missing
early intervention layer between the first signs of struggle and formal
support.

chunks.label: Value Proposition — Our Vision
chunks.text:
We believe the future of workplace wellbeing is proactive, not reactive.

Our vision is to become the world's leading Early Intervention Platform,
helping millions of people access compassionate support at the moment
they need it most.

By empowering earlier conversations, we aim to build healthier people,
stronger organisations and more resilient communities.

chunks.label: Positioning — Our Category
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra is not another wellbeing app.

Pause with Sorra is an AI-powered **Early Intervention Platform**.

We bridge the gap between the first signs of emotional struggle and formal support.

chunks.label: Positioning — The Market We Are Creating
chunks.text:
Traditional workplace wellbeing is largely reactive.

Pause with Sorra is creating a new category:

**Early Intervention as a Service (EIaaS).**

Rather than replacing Occupational Health, Employee Assistance Programmes or therapists, we strengthen the pathway to them.

chunks.label: Positioning — What Makes Us Different
chunks.text:
We do not compete on meditation content.

We do not compete on mindfulness libraries.

We do not compete on therapy marketplaces.

We compete on helping people recognise they are struggling earlier.

chunks.label: Positioning — Competitive Landscape
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra complements rather than replaces:

- Occupational Health
- Employee Assistance Programmes (EAPs)
- Therapists
- Wellbeing providers
- Meditation apps

These services remain important partners.

Pause with Sorra provides the missing early intervention layer before formal support begins.

chunks.label: Positioning — Our Position
chunks.text:
```
Everyday Wellbeing
        ↓
 Pause with Sorra
        ↓
Occupational Health
        ↓
 Clinical Support
```

Pause with Sorra becomes the trusted bridge between self-awareness and professional support.

chunks.label: Positioning — Our Competitive Advantage
chunks.text:
Our differentiation comes from:

- Human-centred AI
- Responsible and explainable AI
- Evidence-informed therapeutic approaches
- Ethical product design
- Early intervention philosophy
- Workplace integration
- Psychological safety
- Trust

Technology alone is not our advantage.

**Trust is.**

chunks.label: Positioning — Our Strategic Moat
chunks.text:
As the platform grows, our long-term advantage will come from:

- Proprietary conversational architecture
- Responsible AI governance
- Trusted workplace partnerships
- Continuous product learning
- High-quality user experience
- A recognised position as the leader in Early Intervention

chunks.label: Positioning — Positioning Statement
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra is the AI-powered Early Intervention Platform that helps people recognise they are struggling, safely explore how they are feeling and take positive action before challenges become overwhelming.

By supporting people earlier, we help organisations create healthier, more resilient workplaces while complementing—not replacing—professional wellbeing services.

chunks.label: Positioning — Category Statement
chunks.text:
Pause with Sorra is creating the Early Intervention category.

Everything we build should reinforce this position.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Purpose
chunks.text:
The purpose of our Go-to-Market strategy is not simply to sell software.

It is to establish Pause with Sorra as the trusted leader in AI-powered Early Intervention.

We will grow through trust, evidence and strategic partnerships rather than aggressive sales.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Our Market Entry Strategy
chunks.text:
Rather than selling directly into large organisations from day one, Pause with Sorra will enter the market through trusted workplace wellbeing partners.

This allows us to:

- Build credibility.
- Generate evidence.
- Improve the platform.
- Reduce procurement barriers.
- Scale through existing relationships.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Phase One — Product Validation
chunks.text:
Objective

Validate that people trust, engage with and benefit from Pause with Sorra.

Activities

- Closed beta testing.
- User interviews.
- Behavioural analytics.
- Clinical review.
- Safety testing.
- AI evaluation.

Success Measures

- Weekly active users.
- Repeat conversations.
- User trust.
- Self-reported impact.
- Net Promoter Score (NPS).
- Qualitative feedback.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Phase Two — Pilot Partnerships
chunks.text:
Objective

Partner with organisations already delivering workplace wellbeing.

Target Partners

- Occupational Health providers.
- Employee Assistance Programme providers.
- Workplace wellbeing consultancies.
- Employee benefit providers.
- Independent HR consultancies.

Offer

A structured pilot programme allowing partners to evaluate the impact of Pause with Sorra before wider deployment.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Phase Three — Commercial Deployment
chunks.text:
Objective

Convert successful pilots into recurring commercial partnerships.

Commercial Model

- Annual platform licence.
- Per-user pricing.
- White-label opportunities.
- API integrations.

Priority

Long-term recurring revenue rather than one-off projects.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Phase Four — Category Leadership
chunks.text:

Activities

- Publish evidence.
- Speak at conferences.
- Build strategic partnerships.
- Produce thought leadership.
- Share research.
- Develop industry frameworks.
- Contribute to responsible AI discussions.

Our ambition is to define the category rather than simply participate in it.

chunks.label: Go-to-Market Strategy — Our Long-Term Strategy

Pause with Sorra will become the infrastructure that enables earlier emotional support across workplaces.

We are not trying to become the biggest wellbeing app.

We are building the trusted platform that organisations choose when they want to support people before challenges become overwhelming.

Helping people pause before life presses pause for them.
